prose: Basis: the source is a short X announcement with a video, so this note rests on the post itself. Cursor can now control your computer: its agents can drive desktop applications - the demo shows the iOS Simulator - to test the features they build. The move takes coding agents beyond the editor and into operating the software they produce, closing the loop between writing code and verifying it runs.
highlights: Cursor agents can now control the computer and drive desktop apps
Demo: driving the iOS Simulator to test features the agent built
Extends coding agents from writing code to operating the resulting software
